text:
maria: Heads up — Compliance asked for a compact "who changed what" export for eDiscovery. They want an API + console flow: searchable stream + on-demand full snapshots. Thoughts on shape & quotas?

samir: +1 we need to be careful on PII. Are they expecting full payloads or just diffs/metadata?

maria: Prefer minimal: actor, timestamp, object_id, change_type, before_hash, after_hash, justification. Full snapshots as enterprise add-on.

kevin: For API shape I'd propose a streaming NDJSON endpoint and a presigned-bundle download for full snapshots. Streaming for realtime compliance hooks.

elaine: Console UX: show compact timeline per-actor with quick filters (tenant, route, prod/dev) and a "Download snapshot" CTA that triggers an export job. Job should appear in Activity > Exports.

samir: Example NDJSON event (very compact):

```
{ "ts":"2024-10-12T14:23:01Z", "actor":"alice@acme", "obj":"route:1234", "op":"update", "before":"sha256:aaa...", "after":"sha256:bbb...", "reason":"add allowlist" }
```

kevin: That looks good. A couple of infra concerns:
- How to handle rate limiting? Large tenants could want full history.
- Signing + retention policies for exported bundles.

maria: Rate limiting: export jobs are quota-metered (export-units). Streaming endpoints have per-tenant CPS + aggregated token quota. We should add a throttle override for legal/contracted requests (with manual approval).

safiya: From telemetry side: we need event-level ingest flags so we can attribute export cost to tenant and route. Also add sampling metadata if the stream is sampled.

elaine: UX note: when someone requests a full snapshot, show estimated size and retention window and require an export reason. Defaults: 30d retention for presigned link, 7d for ephemeral debug bundles.

kevin: For API compatibility: propose endpoints:
- GET /audit/v1/stream?since=...&filter=... (server-sent NDJSON)
- POST /audit/v1/exports { filter, format: ndjson|ndjson-bundle|zip, retention_days } -> returns job id
- GET /audit/v1/exports/<id> for status + presigned URL when ready

samir: Security: HSM/KMS signing of export manifests and include checksums. Also populate actor_id vs display_name, and include resolved actor attributes (role, ip) only if tenant allows PII export.

maria: Agreement: stream + job model + presigned bundles. Next: quotas. My draft rules: streaming read = 0.01 export-unit/sec per connection. Export job cost = size_in_gb * coeff (1 export-unit per GB) + fixed overhead. Enterprise can pay for extra throughput.

kevin: Let's also cap concurrent export jobs per-tenant to 3 by default. Admins can raise. If a tenant hits a quota, console shows "Request increase" which creates a ticket.

safiya: Telemetry: emit events for export_requested, export_started, export_completed, export_failed with tenant_id, job_id, estimated_size_gb, actual_size_gb. Link these to billing.

elaine: UX microflow: user clicks "Download audit", shows modal to choose timeframe and filters, estimates size, requires reason. On submit, a job starts and we show progress with logs and final presigned URL.

samir: One API nuance: should streaming endpoint honor RBAC per-route? e.g., a user may have view-only for routes but not for payloads. We should check permissions per event and redact fields accordingly.

maria: Yes, RBAC enforcement at event emission time + redaction step for exports. Also support a "redaction profile" param on export job: none|minimal|pii-redacted.

kevin: Implementation notes: backend will read from changefeed, transform to NDJSON, and write to S3 for snapshot bundles. For streaming we proxy changefeed -> SSE with backpressure and acking.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: audit-export-worker v2 -> staging at 2024-10-15T02:00Z :rocket:

maria: Next steps: samir + kevin to sketch API proto and quota math. elaine + safiya to draft console wireframes and telemetry event list. I'll collect compliance requirements (retention/legal) and follow up.

kevin: I'll throw up an RFC draft tonight.

samir: I'll start a small spike to estimate cost for a 10TB tenant.

elaine: I'll add a placeholder in the console backlog and link the RFC when ready. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks — sync tomorrow 9am PT to review the RFC and sizing. :eyes:
